title: Of Mice and Men
author: John Steinbeck
description: It's easy to make decisions when not much is at stake. During the Great Depression, two migrant ranch hands, George and Lennie, were trying their best to survive. Lennie is intellectually stunted. During normal times, we as a society will try to take care of such people, but what about the hard times? How will George manage to take care of Lennie's behavior? What difficult decisions would you have to make to protect the people you care about?
reasons: want a classic you can finish in one sitting
like stories about friendship under pressure
want an ending that stays with you for years
are curious about Steinbeck but not ready for 500 pages
